notes.title: Leaderboards are now live!
notes.notes:
When playing with Steam online, you can now scroll the High Score board to see your friends' best scores, your best scores global rank, and the overall top 3 scores for the level you're playing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44744838/aa577810d120a43744e7c1b73834b076c290bf28.png[/img]

This update also provides better support for syncing save files from offline play. If you achieved a new personal best score while offline, it should get uploaded the next time the game is opened while steam is online.

notes.title: Early Access Now Available!
notes.notes:
The first version of [i]Bubble Ball![/i] is now available for purchase!

Currently, you can play the Sports level normally or with custom settings (Ball Launcher on/off and Uniform/Individualized weights).

Any feedback and suggestions in the Community Discussions would be appreciated.

Thanks for playing and have fun! :]
